FAQ

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

How do I start?

Send your request through the form or WhatsApp. We discuss your goal, then start with an assessment.

Where do sessions take place?

In-person sessions are arranged with you directly. Message me on WhatsApp to confirm location and availability.

Do you offer online coaching?

Yes — personalized programs with regular check-ins and adjustments.

How does assessment work?

Initial consultation plus testing, followed by analysis and training recommendations.

How often do we review progress?

Regularly — online coaching includes check-ins and program adjustments.

Can beginners work with you?

Yes. Programs are built around your current level.

Can athletes work with you remotely?

Yes, through Online Coaching and online Mental Performance sessions.

Personal Training: Can the program be customized?

Yes. Every program is built around your goal, level and schedule.

S&C: Do you work with youth athletes and teams?

Yes — youth athletic development and team S&C/performance units are available. Contact me for details.

Mental Performance: Is this psychological therapy?

No. It is performance-focused education and training, not diagnosis or treatment. Cases outside this scope are referred to a specialist.

Nutrition: Is this a medical diet?

No. Guidance is educational and performance-focused, not medical treatment.

ABOUT THE COACH

Performance Without Guesswork.

Coach Abdelrahman Harb is a Sports Performance & Athlete Development Coach focused on helping athletes and individuals reach higher levels of physical performance.

The coaching approach combines assessment, structured programming, scientific principles and continuous progress monitoring.

Every athlete is different. Training should therefore be designed around individual needs, goals and performance data.

Professional Scope

Services are focused on Mental Performance & Sport Psychology Skills for athletes.
